sections.title: Stop Work Authority (SWA) Activation Report
sections.html:
Policy Summary: This form supports MISH 59 by documenting good-faith Stop Work Authority activations when an imminent hazard threatens life, health, or property.

Procedure Capture: Record the hazard observed, the stop/communicate/resolve/resume actions taken, verification of mitigation, and any recognition or follow-up required by the Site Safety Commander.

Task Use: The initiator and the Site Safety Commander complete the report immediately after the hazard is controlled and work is resumed under clear authorization.
